title: AI Browser Auditor — result schemas index
description: Index of every public result schema. Generated from src/core/result-schema.ts; do not edit by hand. See docs/contracts/RESULT_SCHEMA.md for the SemVer policy.

schemas.title: AuditRun
schemas.description: The top-level result of a `runAudit` invocation. Written to audit.json and returned by the audit_url MCP tool's `report_json` artefact.

schemas.title: ScenarioRunResult
schemas.description: Per-(scenario, persona) execution result — nested under AuditRun.results[].

schemas.title: StepResult
schemas.description: Per-step execution record. Includes status, retries, execution_method, and optional signals.

schemas.title: Issue
schemas.description: A single audit issue (severity + description + recommendation).

schemas.title: DimensionScore
schemas.description: Score for one scoring dimension on a 0..10 scale with a justification string.

schemas.title: ConsoleError
schemas.description: A captured browser console error / pageerror / failed request.

schemas.title: CriticResult
schemas.description: Output of the vision critic (runCritic).

schemas.title: GateResult
schemas.description: Calibration gate verdict (passed + violations + computed metrics).

schemas.title: CalibrationReport
schemas.description: Full calibration run report with per-sample agreement details.

schemas.title: BenchmarkReport
schemas.description: Aggregate benchmark report (pass@1, by_difficulty, by_tag, durations).

schemas.title: BenchmarkTaskResult
schemas.description: Per-task benchmark result.

schemas.title: MutationResult
schemas.description: Single instruction-mutation variant (rephrase | decompose | specific).

schemas.title: AuditUrlResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by audit_url.

schemas.title: ExploreUrlResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by explore_url.

schemas.title: CalibrateCriticResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by calibrate_critic.

schemas.title: SeeResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by `see` (N-1 primitive). One-shot navigation snapshot: DOM summary, console errors, screenshot, and an optional vision note.

schemas.title: ActResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by `act` (N-2 primitive). Per-step outcome of an action sequence (goto / click / fill / press / wait / wait_for / scroll / screenshot / act / note) plus a final DOM summary, console errors, and screenshot.

schemas.title: ExtractResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by `extract` (N-4 primitive). Schema-bound structured extraction: caller passes a JSON Schema describing the desired shape, the primitive runs Stagehand's extract() and returns matching `data` plus DOM summary, console errors, and screenshot.

schemas.title: ListPersonasResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by list_personas (array of PersonaSummary).

schemas.title: ListScenariosResult
schemas.description: MCP tool envelope returned by list_scenarios (array of YAML file names).

schemas.title: HistoryEntry
schemas.description: Compact summary of a historical audit run as returned by get_last_report.

schemas.title: PersonaSummary
schemas.description: Short persona descriptor used inside ListPersonasResult.
